title: Electoral Court Orders Removal of Lula Ad Claiming Flávio Bolsonaro Would Cut Social Programs
detail: TSE justice Alexandre de Moraes' successor, minister Mendonça, ordered the removal of a Lula campaign advertisement that alleged Flávio Bolsonaro would cut social programs if elected. The ruling came amid the intensifying second-round presidential campaign, with the electoral court citing the ad as potentially misleading to voters.
